header.pool: Pool: {{pool}} chips (taken whole by the fewest penalty points)
header.penaltyRule: No trump. A=4 K=3 Q=2 J=1 in penalties. The J♥ (Quinola) and the A♦ cost 5 more, plus 5 chips.

hint.reversisAvoidMarked: The Quinola or the A♦ is on the table. Play low — you must not take this.
hint.reversisAvoidPoints: Penalty cards are on the table. Let someone else take it.
hint.reversisLeadSafe: Lead a low card that scores nothing.
hint.reversisDumpHigh: A safe trick — shed a high card while you can.

tutorial.pool: Chips staked on this round. Whoever ends with the **fewest penalty points takes the pool whole**; a tie carries it into the next round.
tutorial.penalty: The point scale: A=4 K=3 Q=2 J=1. On top of that the **Quinola (J♥) and the A♦** cost 5 more each and force 5 chips into the pool.
tutorial.trick: Cards played this trick appear here. There is no trump — the highest card of the led suit wins.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Legal cards carry a green ring. You are not aiming for zero — only for fewer points than the other three.
